articles.headline: What might have been: World Cup exit leaves All Whites with regrets
articles.description: If there was one major emotion emanating from All Whites players as they trudged to their team bus on Friday evening, it was a sense of regret. And it wasn't over their heavy defeat at the hands of the Belgians.

articles.headline: Socceroos confident of being a 'problem' in World Cup knockouts
articles.description: Socceroos midfielder Jackson Irvine is bullish on Australia's chances in the knockouts, while coach Tony Popovic says an eight-day break before their round of 32 clash in Dallas is ideal for recovery.

articles.headline: Panama scouting report: What can England expect from the World Cup minnows?
articles.description: ESPN talks to Panamian journalist Luis Arauz to get the lowdown on England's final group stage opponents.

articles.headline: Lineker, Shearer, Owen, Rooney, Kane - is England's near half-century of world-class strikers about to end?
articles.description: With an elite striker having worn the Three Lions on their chest for 42 years, England have taken the position for granted - but is Harry Kane the last?

articles.headline: Why are there hydration breaks at the 2026 World Cup, and why has FIFA been criticised?
articles.description: All 104 matches at the 2026 World Cup are stopping for two hydration breaks. Why have they been stipulated by FIFA, and why have they been criticised?
